title: Sweep-in Account - Fixed Deposit and Account name matching requirement
text: I agree that my Fixed Deposit(s) linked for Sweep-in facility to my Savings account/current account should be in the same name(s) and title as my account.

title: Sweep-in Account - predetermined period and breaking units on sweep-out
text: I agree that all Sweep-in deposits will be for a predetermined period only. I authorise the Bank to break units of deposits formed due to Sweep-out instruction in case there is insufficient balance in my linked savings/current account.

title: Sweep-in Account - principal amount only considered, not interest
text: I am aware and acknowledge that only the principal amount of the fixed deposit/s and not the interest will be considered for sweep in facility. Accordingly, Bank shall not be liable for any consequences arising out of non-compliance of any payment instructions due to insufficiency of principal amount to honour payments under sweep-in facility.

title: Sweep-in Account - multiple deposits linkage FIFO and LIFO method
text: I am aware that, in case of linkage of more than one deposit to the Savings/Current Account for a Sweep-in, the system will first Sweep-in funds from the oldest deposit opened, i.e., the deposit which was first linked to the Savings/Current Account based on the First-In-First-Out method. Effective 22nd Feb 2014, Sweep in of funds from your Fixed Deposit (FD) to Saving/Current account will trigger on Last in First out basis (LIFO).

title: Sweep-in Account - same-day restoration of swept FD
text: Same-Day Restoration of Sweep-In Fixed Deposit (FD) - In the event funds are withdrawn/swept from a Fixed Deposit linked to a savings account, the Bank may, at its sole discretion, allow restoration of the withdrawn FD amount subject to the conditions below.

title: Sweep-in Account - redeposit condition for restoration
text: If the utilized/swept amount is fully or partially redeposited into the linked account on the same day before 11:00 PM (IST), the Bank may restore the Fixed Deposit to the extent of the amount redeposited.

title: Sweep-in Account - restoration processing end-of-day
text: Restoration, if applicable, will be processed end-of-day and shall be subject to system availability and successful reconciliation of funds.
